title: Bacho uthao aake janaza jawan ka
body:
Uthta nahi zaeef se lasha jawaan ka
Bacho uthao aake janaza jawan ka.
Thame huwe kamar ko sada dete the hussain
khyme me kis tarha tumhe le-jau noor e ayn
Lyla sahegi kis tarha sadma jawan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO....
<<DIVIDER>>
Shahe huda ki ankh se ansu tapakte the
Jab ran me aydhiya'n ali akbar ragadte the
Dekhega baap kaise tadapna jawan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ansaar me ghareeb ke koi nahi raha
Darya kanaare qatl hua bhai bawafa
Barchi ke sath dekha kaleja jawan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO...
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanhaayi chaar su hai sahara nahi koi
Pyaase ka haaye chaahne waala nahi koi
Kaise ho daagh dil ko gawaara jawaan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO....
<<DIVIDER>>
Bole hussain gham ye uthauga kis tarha
Zainab ko tere haal dikhunga kis tarha
Dooba huwa hai khoon me chehra jawaan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO...
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadma azeem dasht me shabbir seh chuke
Moula ka haal dekh ke zalim ye kehte the
Zinda hai ya ke mar gaya baba jawaan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ki thi fughaa'n ke ye gham Seh Na Paaungi
Armaan tha ke ghar teri dulhan mai laaungi
Dulhan na aayi aaya janaza jawaan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO....
<<DIVIDER>>
Yasrab me Sughra Har Ghadi Bechain Hoti Hai
Akbar ke naqshe pa se lipatkar wo roti hai Aur khaab me sajati Hai sehra jawaan ka
<<MINI>>
BACHO UTHAO ...
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil ka sukoo shabih e payambar thi samne
Kya likhe zain Lasha e akber ki saamne
Ibne Ali Ke Lab Pe Tha Nouha jawaan ka
Uthta nahi zaref se lasha........
